entries.title: Attunement stones
highlights: Attunement Stone recipes in the crafting cube have a Craft all button. It turns the whole ore stack in the cube into stones in one click.

entries.title: Deeper Mastery
highlights: Deeper Mastery is three tiers. Spells start at skill level 1, then 2, then already mastered. Costs 1, then 2, then 3 Ascension Points.

entries.title: Plague & Execution
highlights: Tao and Universal weapons can roll a Plague mana-cost reduction (10–40%). Armour and jewellery can roll a smaller version.
Glyph of Execution still hits for 2.5× damage. The heavier blow is now 7×, and only while the target is below 40% HP.
The Codex has a Glyphs section. It lists every glyph by class, what it changes, and whether you have found it.

entries.title: Awakened weapons & Ascension powers
highlights: New Ascension powers: Head Start (each new world begins with 10 Rebirth Points per tier, uncapped), Resonant Start (Soul Resonance from the start, 6 points; the 200 RP purchase cannot stack), Greater DC/MC/SC/AC/AMC (uncapped, +20% per tier), and Mega Formula (Samuel sells Mega Potion, then Ultra Potion, with faster potion ticks while they recover).
Each Evil Mir journey now pays 8 Standard, 9 Empowered, 10 Ascended, 11 Awakened.
Poison Cloud stays on the ground like Fire Wall. Weapons can roll extra Poison Cloud damage and duration; jewellery can roll a little duration.
Added Awakened Blade of Sorcery, Heaven Sword, Burst Sword, Dragon Blood Sword, Holy Blood Spear, Black Tiger Hammer, Staff of Lotus, Fan of Crane, Sword of War God, Holy Light Sword, and Mir Sword.
Dragon Sword now requires Max DC 30 to equip, matching Crystal. Past Bicheon mobs play their attack, flinch, and death sounds.
Blade Avalanche no longer lets other warrior melee attacks hit from 3 tiles away. Those skills close to melee again. Blade Avalanche itself is unchanged.

entries.title: Smaller saves, Options tabs & Taoist healing
highlights: Saves are much smaller. Full bags and storage should fit cloud backup again.
The Time Logging (XP/h) window can be dragged by its title bar. Its position is remembered.
Options is split into Gameplay, Saves/Backups, and Audio tabs.
Taoists can set Healing and Mass Healing HP thresholds in Options > Gameplay, same as auto potions.

entries.title: Ascension
highlights: Ascension is live. Kill Evil Mir and the Traveller in town will send you back to the start. Characters, gold, items, rebirth upgrades, the Codex, and achievements reset. Token unlocks and a supporter month stay. Boss Junk Filter turns off so a fresh world drops gear again; your junk list is kept.

Each journey pays Ascension Points once, for the hardest form of him you beat: 5 Standard, 7 Empowered, 9 Ascended, 11 Awakened. Points bank forever; powers can only be chosen while you are ascending.
If you already killed him before this update, that kill counts as a Standard 5. Beat a harder form before you leave to claim the rest.

Powers: Swift Learning (less XP per level), Soul Beacon (every boss drops an Awakened Soul), Soul Exchange (souls are worth more Rebirth Points), Empowered Start (Boss Empowerment from the start), Steeper Path (world difficulty), Traveller's Supplies (a shop on the Traveller), and Havoc Surplus (extra crystals when salvaging). Deeper Mastery is still coming.

Steeper Path (2 points) opens a Difficulty window in town: Normal, Hard 1.25×, Extreme 1.5×, Insane 1.75×, Impossible 2×. Monster HP and damage, XP, gold, and drop rates all scale. Empowered / ascended / awakened boss buffs stack on top.

Traveller's Supplies sells gear and skill books up to a level cap that rises with each tier (11 / 16 / 22 / 28 / 33). Havoc Surplus adds a 25% chance per tier that salvage pays another copy of those crystals.
A Journey window tracks this world's time and your best clears. Saves from before this update show Not timed for the world you are already on.
Storage can hold two extra pages (80 slots each). Each costs 100 tokens and is account-wide.
The Item Codex now only lists items that drop from monsters or bosses. Shop-only gear, unused gender variants, glyphs, ores, and other non-drop items are gone. Uniques and Empowerments are unchanged.
The Social level cap is now 150.

entries.title: Evil Mir & the Mir set
highlights: Added Past Bicheon floors 6-9 and Evil Mir himself at the end of them, plus the Mir set.
Kill Evil Mir and a Traveller appears in town. He offers Ascension, coming in the next update.
Added Empowered Harvest, a Rebirth upgrade that lets non-boss equipment drops roll empowered (same star odds as Empowered bosses). 1 in 100, then 1 in 75, 1 in 50, and 1 in 25.
Glyph of Infinite Mana can now be used by any class.
Rebirth now warns you if the Spirit Box is unlocked but empty, so you can store an item before resetting.

entries.title: Random Mystery Cave, glyphs & Awakened weapons
highlights: Added Random Mystery Cave. Craft a ticket from 1 Wooma Heart + 1 Black Iron Ore (any purity). Infinite remix of walking monsters, once per day per account. Gold and EXP are a gamble up to a ceiling that grows with kills; loot every 5 kills.
Crystal Spider and Red Evil Ape now appear in Mystery Cave.
Added 7 glyphs: Execution, Shared Skin, Last Stand, Blight, Focused Meteor, Blood Shield, and Provision.
Added a fifth glyph equip slot (Rebirth upgrade, 1000 RP).
Oma King can drop the Immortal Skin book.
Added Awakened Dragon Staff and Awakened Soul Sabre (Bone Lord), and Awakened Dragon Slayer (Minotaur King).
Added Boss Junk Filter — bosses skip plain copies of auto-junked items. Buy in Rebirth (100 RP) or Cash Shop (300 tokens).
In group dungeons and KR, drag an item onto another character's paper doll or nameplate to pass it (out of combat).

entries.title: Past Bicheon & Mystery Cave
highlights: Added Past Bicheon group dungeon with Frost Tiger and Oma King. Designed to be incredibly difficult and end game. Evil Mir to come soon.
Added new items and spell books for Frost Tiger and Oma King drops.
Added Mystery Cave. Craft a Mystery Cave Ticket to run a boss swarm. Wipe or clear for a chest with a choice of rewards.
Vampirism casts first when the Wizard is below 80% HP.

entries.title: Armoury, glyphs & balance
highlights: Added Armoury kits at Blacksmith Bill — save and swap gear kits in town (2 free per character; 3rd kit in the Cash Shop for 300 tokens).
Added 9 new glyphs.
Added a fourth glyph equip slot (Rebirth upgrade, 750 RP).
Glyph of Mana Aegis now keeps Magic Shield at half damage reduction instead of removing it.
Flaming Sword cooldown can no longer drop below 3 seconds.
Holy Deva thunder now scales from your SC (×2) instead of a fixed pet DC.
Additive damage reduction is now capped at 75%.
Automatic cloud backups now wait 2 minutes after opening the game or tabbing back in, so you can restore from another device first without overwriting the newer save.

entries.title: Glyph fix, Awakened drops & mining upgrades
highlights: Fixed glyph crafting bug.
Fixed drops for a couple of Awakened weapons.
Added rebirth upgrades for better ore mining rates.

entries.title: Unique weapons, Attunement Stones & Idle
highlights: Added 3 new unique weapons.
Added Attunement Stones to the crafting recipes. These increase your chance of targeting their respective empowerment types when rerolling.
Fixed a few bugs.
Added a manual button to start Idle mode for more control.
Added ore stacking (doesn't work for Black Iron Ore) as both a rebirth point upgrade and a cash shop upgrade.
Nerfed Dark Devil AOE damage.

entries.title: Awakened bosses, Namman & Glyphs
highlights: Added a third glyph equip slot (Rebirth upgrade).
Added Namman Demon Fields and Danmo to Southern Barbarian Lands.
Added Glyph Recycling to the crafting cube — turn 2 glyphs you don't want into a random new one.
Added more stats to the Stats 2 page.
Added Awakened bosses — the next (and final) tier up for bosses.
Added 3 new Awakened items. These can be seen in the Codex and only drop from specific Awakened bosses.
Unique items (including Awakened weapons) can no longer be sealed in the Spirit Box, same as Ethereal gear.
Changed Glyph of Disruptor Cascade to be more useful.

entries.title: New zones, glyphs & dungeon auto-advance
highlights: Added Southern Barbarian Land and Hell Lord.
Added 8 new glyphs.
Added Auto-junk filters — drag bag items onto the pad to auto-mark future plain copies as junk.
Your player ID is now tied to your recovery code to help reduce duplicate accounts.
Ascended bosses now have a higher chance to drop glyphs.
Empowered and Ascended bosses now get extra rolls for Awakening Souls.
Cash Shop: Group Dungeon Auto Advance (200 tokens) — tick Auto advance next to the Advance button in multi-stage group dungeons (Black Dragon Dungeon, Hell Cavern, and future ones).
Using a skill book you already know adds +200 skill XP to that spell (consumes the book). No effect if the skill is mastered or you are under the next skill-level character requirement.

entries.title: Shared gold, UI & Options
highlights: Gold is now account-wide, not character-specific.
Added character-specific HP and MP auto potion sliders in the Options menu.
Added back the UI update with some changes.
Fixed character selection UI size issue.
Removed HP and MP flashing.
You can now toggle the Mir GUI or the Idle text-based GUI in the top right of the game window.
Mir GUI is automatically removed on mobile devices.

entries.title: Ice Hell, Glyphs & Ascended
highlights: Added Ice Hell wing to Hell Cavern.
Added more Glyphs.
BDD and all the other bosses can now be empowered.
Added Ascended mode. Like Empowered, but bosses drop even more.
Added new level 50 Heaven Armour.
Change Tao pet so it now teleports when out of combat.
Added Poison Cloud to drops.

entries.title: Fox Cave, late game & Glyphs
highlights: Added Fox Cave 1, 2 and KR.
Added Greater Fox Spirit and Fox items.
Rebalanced current late game items and armours.
Added new late game armour and weapons.
Added drops to Hell Guardian.
Added Plague to Dark and Dream Devourer drops.
Added Glyphs — 10% chance to drop from Empowered bosses. Only 7 in game at the moment while they get tested.
Fixed duplication bug (Thanks SmavidDavid).

entries.title: Codex, achievements & UI
highlights: Added Empowerments to the Codex.
Added new achievements.
Slightly moved the Sort button.
Added Testing Room to the trainer so you can measure your DPS.

entries.title: Boss souls & Spirit Box
highlights: New crafting recipe: IWT Soul — teleport directly to Incarnated Wooma Taurus.
New crafting recipe: IZT Soul — teleport directly to Incarnated Zuma Taurus.
New crafting recipe: DD Soul — teleport directly to Dark Devil.
New rebirth item: Spirit Box — save one non-Ethereal item between rebirths for 100 souls or 200 tokens.

entries.title: What's New
highlights: Patch notes are now in-game. Open Options → What's New anytime, or tap What's new on the update bar before you reload.
